title: FullRep: Workout & Nutrition
shortDescription: Track workouts, calories & macros — with barcode scanner & training plans
fullDescription:
FullRep combines workout tracking and nutrition tracking in one app —
clean, fast and clutter-free. Whether you're a beginner or advanced:
track your workouts, calories and progress in one place.

TRAINING
• 240+ exercises with descriptions: strength, cardio, HIIT, circuit & martial arts
• Log sets, reps and weight — with rest timer
• Personal records detected automatically ("New PR!")
• 21 ready-made training programs: Push/Pull/Legs, Upper/Lower, 5-day split, HIIT and more
• Custom training plans and weekly schedules with calendar
• Full workout history, editable afterwards
• Notes and machine settings per exercise

NUTRITION
• Calories and macros (protein, carbs, fat) with clean progress rings
• Barcode scanner: scan a product, get its nutrition instantly
• AI photo recognition: snap your meal — calories and macros are estimated
• Huge food database (Open Food Facts + local database)
• TDEE calculator and fully adjustable goals
• Water tracking with daily goal
• Cookbook with 25 high-protein recipes incl. portion calculator
• 8 diet guides (calorie deficit, IF 16:8, carb cycling and more)

PROGRESS & MOTIVATION
• Weight chart (7 days up to 1 year)
• XP system with levels and workout streaks
• Add friends, start challenges, weekly leaderboard

ALSO INCLUDED
• Supplement tracker with weekly schedule
• Cycle tracking with phase-based training and nutrition tips
• Dark and light mode, 13 languages (German, English, Spanish, French, Portuguese, Arabic, Italian, Dutch, Polish, Turkish, Japanese, Korean, Chinese), kg or lbs
• Guest mode: try everything before signing up
• Works offline — your data syncs automatically

Download FullRep and get closer to your goal every week.

IMPORTANT HEALTH NOTICE
FullRep does not replace medical advice. For any health concern, diagnosis or treatment, always consult a doctor. In particular, talk to a doctor before starting a training or nutrition programme, before a diet and before taking any supplement — especially if you have a pre-existing condition or symptoms, are pregnant, or take medication. All content in the app is for general information and is not a medical device.
